profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker EH and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001759783. On its own website, EHang describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. The company says it serves customers across industries with AAV products and commercial solutions, listing urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. Its site also points to emergency rescue and infrastructure solutions, along with news, video, partner, investor relations and careers sections.

The site presents EHang as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry, a characterization the company makes about itself. Beyond that positioning, the material available is limited: no specific products, litigation, or other corporate developments are recorded alongside this profile.
